proposals.before: In the eighth month on jiawu the death testament reached the capital and the imperial great-grandson was sent to meet the bier at Kaiping.
proposals.after: In the eighth month on jiachen the death testament reached the capital and the imperial great-grandson was sent to meet the bier at Kaiping.
proposals.reason: 甲辰 is jiachen, not jiawu (甲午).

proposals.before: In the eighth month on jiawu the final edict arrived; the imperial great-grandson was dispatched to receive the coffin at Kaiping.
proposals.after: In the eighth month on jiachen the final edict arrived; the imperial great-grandson was dispatched to receive the coffin at Kaiping.
proposals.reason: 甲辰 is jiachen, not jiawu.

proposals.before: On disi he ascended the throne.
proposals.after: On dingsi he ascended the throne.

proposals.reason: 己巳 is jisi; jiwei is 己未.

proposals.after: On bingyin Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu crushed the rebels of Pingle and Xunzhou.

proposals.before: On bingyin Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan broke the Pingyao and Xunzhou tribes.
proposals.after: On bingyin Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan broke the Pingle and Xunzhou tribes.
proposals.reason: 平樂 is Pingle, not Pingyao.

decisions.reason: s0039 has 八月甲辰; 甲辰 is jiachen, while jiawu is 甲午, so the idiomatic day name must be corrected.
The same 八月甲辰 requires literal jiachen rather than jiawu; the rest of the sentence already matches 遺詔至，遣皇太孫迎喪開平.
s0041 opens with 丁巳; the sexagenary reading is dingsi, and disi is a malformed romanization of that day.
Literal English likewise misreads 丁巳 as disi; dingsi restores the correct day name without changing the accession wording.
s0052 has 己巳; that day is jisi, whereas jiwei is 己未, so the idiomatic date is wrong.
The literal field repeats the same 己巳→jiwei error; jisi matches the Chinese day name.
s0098 has 平樂、潯州蠻; 平樂 is Pingle, not Pingyao (平遙), so the place name in the idiomatic must change.
Literal English likewise turns 平樂 into Pingyao; Pingle restores the Guangxi place named in the Chinese.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0007 shows the English action string inherited Pingyao from the bad translation of 平樂; the event remains valid but must name Pingle instead.
